title: Microsoft Copilot: add agents and skills from the plus menu
summary: The roadmap facts, admin paths and preview Graph automation are supported. Two minor corrections remain: name the deciding request property in the User access row, and qualify the broad statement that Premium includes agent usage to acknowledge Microsoft's more specific billing guidance.
